svg.text: In order to facilitate sizing and placement of graphic

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: components a grid has been superimposed. The

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: dimensions of the grid squares (‘y’) are in a ratio of

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: 1:12 to the longest side of sign, e.g. where the

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: longest side of the sign is 8 feet, ‘y’ is 8 inches.
